output.content:
**Answer: the fastest feasible recipe is 0.2 Torr chamber pressure with a −5 °C shelf, drying completely at 17.79 h, with a thermal margin of 0.70 °C below T_pr_crit and an equipment-line margin of about 2.08 kg/h of headroom.**

This corrects the draft I saved mid-task, which is wrong and must not be used: its numeric fields (12.16 h, −15.82 °C, 1.079 kg/h) came from the thermally infeasible 0.1 Torr/10 °C run, and its whole-batch rate used a bad area conversion. The system froze that draft as requiring review and would not let me revise it, so the figures below are the authoritative ones.

Evidence per simulated pair (LyoPRONTO 1.2.0 native runs of the characterization source, 398 vials, product area 3.14 cm² per vial → 0.125 m² whole batch, derived):

- **0.2 Torr / −5 °C**: complete at 17.79 h; max returned vial-bottom −18.70 °C (limit −18.0 °C, margin 0.70 °C); peak flux 0.631 kg/h/m² → whole-batch peak ≈ 0.079 kg/h vs line −0.182 + 11.7×0.2 = 2.158 kg/h, margin ≈ 2.079 kg/h.
- Faster pairs all breach the vial-bottom limit: 0.2 Torr/10 °C (10.97 h, −13.84 °C), 0.1 Torr/10 °C (12.16 h, −15.82 °C), 0.05 Torr/10 °C (13.02 h, −17.07 °C — above −18 °C, so infeasible, contrary to my earlier draft).
- Other thermally feasible completes are slower: 0.1 Torr/−5 °C 18.85 h (bottom −20.58 °C), 0.05 Torr/−5 °C 19.67 h (−21.78 °C), 0.2 Torr/−15 °C 29.35 h. 0.2 Torr/−25 °C did not complete within the 60 h horizon (88.25 % dried).

What I could not check: four of the twelve allowed pairs (0.05 and 0.1 Torr at −15 °C and −25 °C) were never simulated — I ran out of budget. From the monotone pattern in the simulated runs (colder shelf → slower drying, and even −5 °C at those pressures already takes 18.85–19.67 h), none of them can beat 17.79 h, but that is inference, not a checked run. Temperature checks are on returned solver nodes only, with no continuous-maximum guarantee, and this is an authored simulator-world case (synthetic example, no experimental measurements) — not validation, not an approval, and no equipment was operated.
